scope: Disposable loopback PostgreSQL and local Express only. No production/staging access, deployment, backup changes or external integration calls.
method: Synthetic loopback HTTP against the real Express app and migrated PostgreSQL. Authentication validates persisted hashed sessions through requireAuth; password login is not exercised. First-process samples use a fresh API process per request, with warm database pages and process imports excluded. Warm requests mix surfaces, profiles and two sessions per profile under a bounded shared concurrency. Client timing includes response-body receipt; server timing includes authentication and serialization. Active-pool interval samples are observations, not individual query wait times. No Nginx, TLS, browser rendering, external API or production load is measured.

exploratoryIncident.conclusion: The replay shows sensitivity to small-table estimates and a different plan after ANALYZE, but did not reproduce the original timeout and does not establish its cause. Benchmark fixture preparation now runs ANALYZE before requests. The final complete cohort had no unexpected errors.

limitations: Local HTTP timings and a synthetic workload do not establish production acceptance or browser LCP/useful-content performance.
Three fresh-process samples per route/profile yield a median; their p95 is suppressed below 100 samples.
Session authentication is real; password login, TLS, Nginx, rendering and frontend polling are outside this scenario.
Pool waiting-zero target remains unmet under concurrency four; no connection limit was raised.
Worker freshness checks cover project/group progress and point hours. Card reads after writes check permissions; immediate card-cache freshness is not asserted.
The exploratory timeout was not reproduced and remains an incident to investigate if repeated.
The planned cold-service reduction in all target scenarios, published 24-hour/seven-day acceptance and retention policy/application remain pending; backups remain deferred.
refreshTimeOrigin: Start of the verification round after acknowledged worker writes and sampler reset; not the exact server commit timestamp.
